$comment: Small hints that appear the first time something happens (D294 proposed). Each can be dismissed, with a Dont-show-again box. Plain words, no names.

hints.title: Recording stopped
hints.text: You chose to be asked, so Ujwalam is asking whether to make clips from this recording. You can change that choice in Settings, Clips.

hints.title: Making clips
hints.text: Finding your best moments: reading the game screen, then cutting clips. Progress is in the bar at the bottom.

hints.title: A match was skipped
hints.text: This match was skipped because you were not in the top 3 and did not reach the number of kills you set, if you set one. You can change this in Settings, Clips.

hints.title: You are live
hints.text: While you are live, clip videos are made after the stream. Only light work runs now, such as saving marked moments, so your stream stays smooth.

hints.title: This layer has an effect
hints.text: Effects such as rounded corners or shadows are listed in Look. Change them with the sliders, or switch them off.

hints.title: Behind the scenes
hints.text: Ujwalam just started a job. Jobs are listed in this bar so you can see what is happening. Click it for the list.
